name: Sopa de Albóndigas
summary: Beef and rice meatballs simmered in a tomato broth with potatoes and carrots. One pot, no breadcrumbs.

ingredients.name: long-grain white rice (raw, for the meatballs)

instructions: Mix the beef, raw rice, egg, 1 tsp oregano, half the garlic, and 0.5 tsp salt. Roll into 16 meatballs.
Blend or finely chop the tomatoes with half the onion and the rest of the garlic.
In a large pot, bring the tomato mixture, broth, 750 mL water, cumin, and remaining oregano to a boil.
Drop in the meatballs one at a time. Simmer 15 minutes without stirring so they set.
Add the carrots, potatoes, and the rest of the onion (diced). Simmer 15–20 minutes until the vegetables are tender and the rice in the meatballs is cooked. Season with salt.

glutenFree.notes: The meatballs are bound with rice and egg, not breadcrumbs, so they're naturally gluten-free. Check the broth label.

budgetNotes: Close to the $15 limit because of the beef: $7.60 of the $14.14.
The raw rice cooks inside the meatballs and gives them their soft texture. Don't use cooked rice.
A zucchini ($0.66) is common in this soup but would take it to $14.80. Add it only if you already have one.

pricingMetadata.notes: Medium ground beef $19.00/kg (400 g = $7.60). Rice $0.25/100 g. Egg $0.33. Diced tomatoes $2.00. Broth $1.69/900 mL (Campbell's). Carrots ~$2.93/kg. Russets $0.66/kg. Onion $1.07. Garlic $0.08/clove. Spices estimated.
